messages:
tara_cs: FYI HorizonPark usage plunged ~90% after their SSO cutover this morning. Nightly inference jobs stalled. They opened ticket HP-824 and mentioned a parallel competitor PoC. :warning:
evan_csm: Got it. Ticket notes intermittent 401s then some 502s. Procurement wants a remediation plan within 48h. Reached out to their ML lead (carlos) but no answer yet.
mike_solutions: I offered a quick 20-min unblock session + sandbox creds. Customer asked for an SSO troubleshooting checklist and an exec note about containment. I'll draft both.
liya_eng: From traces: auth-exchange errors at ~02:28-02:34 UTC -> kvcache-miss -> routing-fallback -> occasional 502. If they paste one raw failing request/response we can repro. We can also spin up an auth-proxy + temp key. ETA ~4-6h after customer approval.
tara_cs: Copy of HP-824 message: "Post-SSO migration, our inference pipeline returns 401 or times out to 502. We're evaluating an alternate vendor this week if this isn't resolved fast."
evan_csm: Sales asked if we can offer a short containment: 14-day dedicated bridge with priority eng onboarding (timeboxed). No permanent discount. Agree?
mike_solutions: Fine with that if procurement signs a mitigation acknowledgement. I'll include rollback steps in the playbook: rotate token, use proxy, re-point clients.
liya_eng: Tech snippet to share with them:
```
REQUEST 2025-04-11T02:29:12Z -> 401 Unauthorized
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Trace: auth-exchange-failed -> kvcache-miss -> routing-fallback -> 502
```
tara_cs: Action items: 1) Mike request raw request+response from HorizonPark (ASAP). 2) Liya prep auth-proxy + sandbox key standby. 3) Evan coordinate commercial note + mitigation ack with sales. 4) Tara schedule 30-min troubleshooting session with ML lead and invite eng + solutions.
ticket-bot: Ticket HP-824 updated by tara_cs at 2025-04-11T09:22Z
evan_csm: I'll draft the commercial guardrail and loop procurement. Mike, drop the checklist here when ready and I'll attach to the ticket.
mike_solutions: Dropping a short checklist now: 1) Paste raw failing request/response. 2) Check token TTL/clock skew and rotate service token. 3) Run smoke job with sandbox creds. 4) If failures persist, enable auth-proxy and run smoke again. 5) Sign mitigation acknowledgement to accept timeboxed bridge.
tara_cs: Scheduling the meeting for 14:00 HorizonPark local. Will update thread when accepted. :thumbsup:
